title: [WIP] Octree ray tracing
abstract:
Implements a ray tracer for octree.
See the tests for how to use it.

The datasets are RAMSES datasets, with a single CPU and an AMR structure with `levelmin=1`, i.e. the octree is complete from the root node.
- [ramses_shallow.tar.gz](https://github.com/yt-project/yt/files/4161516/ramses_shallow.tar.gz)
- [ramses_deep_noamr.tar.gz](https://github.com/yt-project/yt/files/4161517/ramses_deep_noamr.tar.gz)

# TODO
- [x] make it work for sparse octrees,
- [x] handle multiple domains (need to switch the ray from one octree to another one),
- [x] handle leaf cells that are *not* selected,
- [ ] make this work for rays sent in negative directions (-x, -y, -z),
- [ ] wire things together with the volume renderer.
